name: KRA eTIMS and Tax Management
scope_from_master_specification: KRA PIN, branch/till and tax classification; VAT; invoice transmission via applicable authorized OSCU/VSCU method; KRA responses/identifiers/QR where required; credit/debit notes, corrections and permitted cancellations; supplier invoices; history/export; retries/duplicate prevention; VAT summaries, tax periods, estimates, reminders, payment references, authorized payment channels and reconciliation. Returns filing and tax payments are separate unless KRA explicitly authorizes APIs.
